verdict.rationale: Circle Payments Network documents cross-border fiat payouts. Senders get real-time FX quotes, settle in USDC onchain, and payout partners deliver local fiat to the receiver, with self-managed and managed models. Circle Mint separately covers USD↔USDC conversion. Delivery depends on third-party payout partners, and the evidence never publishes which currencies or countries are covered. Missing for 10: a published list of supported currencies and countries, documentation of the specific bank-transfer rails used by partners, and independent or hands-on corroboration of off-ramp payouts.
